note: Subclasses (roadmap item 60; core/game/game_subclass.gd). A subclass is a calling layered on an heir's class: none or one, taken by anyone, whatever their class, and it adds small bonuses to what the class already does and never replaces its skills. A subclass is picked when the dynasty is founded, taken later by the living heir for gold, or passed to a child (born to it). One chosen at the founding or inherited is 'founded': its perks are stronger by `founder_scale`; one taken later gives them at their plain strength. A perk is a multiplier on a number the rules already have (1.4 is 40% more, 0.85 is 15% less); the founded strength is 1 + (m - 1) x founder_scale. Every perk key below is read by one place in the rules through GameSubclass.perk (the `perks` text says what it multiplies). `price_mult` scales what the calling costs to take (default 1). Each calling's own items (its works) are in data/items/items.json: an item with a `subclass` and a `recipe` {cost, fee, min_level} is made only by that calling (GameSubclass.work_plan / make) and is sold in no shop; a few brews are its own too (`calling_brews` in craft.json).

perks.find_mult: the chance of finding eggs and young
perks.keep_mult: the yearly cost of keeping creatures
perks.fertility_mult: how often a breeding pair has young
perks.mutation_mult: how often young are born with a new trait
perks.forge_fee_mult: what a forge charges for a piece or a brew
perks.craft_quality_mult: the craftsmanship a maker's level gives
perks.salvage_mult: the material got back from broken-up gear
perks.gather_mult: the materials a hunt's dead leave
perks.essence_mult: the chance of an essence from the dead
perks.brew_yield_mult: what a batch of brew makes
perks.sell_mult: what merchants pay you for gear
perks.drop_mult: the chance of a made item from the dead
perks.rarity_mult: the chance such items are rare
perks.forage_mult: what you take when you forage
perks.raid_mult: the chance of raids on the house
perks.disease_mult: the chance of catching a sickness
perks.flee_mult: your chance to get away from a fight

subclasses.name: Breeder
subclasses.about: Raises creatures for a living: finds young more often, keeps them cheaper, breeds them better and sells them dearer.

subclasses.name: Runescribe
subclasses.about: Inscribes scrolls and sigils: pulls more essence from the dead, makes finer pieces for a smaller fee and gives spells an edge.

subclasses.name: Armorer
subclasses.about: Forges and mends armour and weapons: finer pieces, a cheaper forge, more back from broken gear and a tougher hide of one's own.

subclasses.name: Bladewright
subclasses.about: Hammers edges onto steel: harder blows, sharper made pieces, and a better price when gear is sold on.

subclasses.name: Enchanter
subclasses.about: Binds charms into wands, staves and rings: stronger spells, rarer finds from the dead and better-made pieces.

subclasses.name: Alchemist
subclasses.about: Distils brews and tinctures: a batch makes more, a potion mends more, and the body is harder to sicken.

subclasses.name: Artificer
subclasses.about: Builds clockwork, hinges and harnesses: cheaper building, a cheaper forge, a lighter pack and a surer swing of the pick.

subclasses.name: Gemwright
subclasses.about: Cuts and sets stones: strikes more ore, sells gear dearer and finds finer made pieces.

subclasses.name: Hidewright
subclasses.about: Tans hides and sews leather armour: more from every kill, more from every break-up, a thicker coat and a bigger pack.

subclasses.name: Trapsmith
subclasses.about: Sets snares, deadfalls and spring-guns: raiders think twice, escapes come easier and a hunt pays a little more.

subclasses.name: Spiritbinder
subclasses.about: Binds the restless dead into lanterns and staves: spells carry weight, hunts teach more and sickness finds little hold.

subclasses.name: Wildcaller
subclasses.about: Calls and trains beasts of the field: companions haul more, young are found more often, creatures cost less to keep and training teaches more.

subclasses.name: Feastwright
subclasses.about: Cooks for the road and the hall: forages more, stews that mend more than a potion, a hardy table and a well-provisioned pack.

subclasses.name: Wayfinder
subclasses.about: Maps the land and scouts ahead: easier to slip away, more from a forage, companions that bring in more and finds on the dead.

subclasses.name: Delver
subclasses.about: Digs deep and shores up: strikes more ore, digs harder, fears the roof less and carries the haul.

subclasses.name: Stonewright
subclasses.about: Raises walls that last: building costs far less, raiders have a harder time and the house stands a little firmer.

subclasses.name: Greenwarden
subclasses.about: Keeps the hedgerow and the physic garden: forages the most, rarely falls sick, mends better and farms well.

subclasses.name: Steadholder
subclasses.about: Works a freehold: farm animals give more, creatures cost less to keep, odd jobs pay and raiders are put off.

subclasses.name: Caravaneer
subclasses.about: Trades from the wagon: buys cheaper, sells dearer, picks up better pay for odd jobs and carries more.

subclasses.name: Venomwright
subclasses.about: Brews venom and anti-venom: a sharper blow, a bigger haul from the dead, more made pieces found and a stomach for sickness.

text.taken: {h} takes up the calling of a {name} for {gold} gold.
text.changed: {h} gives up the calling of a {old} to become a {name}, for {gold} gold.
text.inherited: {h} is born to the calling of a {name}, as {parent} was.
text.outside_life: Only a living heir can take a subclass.
text.work_level: It takes a maker of level {level}.
text.work_short: Short of {material}: {need} needed, {have} in the stores.
text.work_made: {h} makes a {name}, a work of the {calling}.
text.works_where: Works are made at a forge: a town's, or the family's own at the workshop.
